request.description: What the user asked for; this is not evidence of completion.

diff.description: Proposed patch, file excerpt, or change summary (whole-change review). Truncated at 50000 chars. Provide exactly one of diff or files.

files.description: Per-file review: one { path, diff } per file. The rubric is asked once per file, all in one request; the whole change is auto only when every file is auto, and the review names the limiting file and rubric. Each diff is truncated at 50000 chars; up to 16 files, and request + tests + all diffs together must stay within 200,000 chars. Provide exactly one of diff or files.

claims.description: Completion claims to check against evidence, each truncated at 2000 chars. Up to 16 per call.

id.description: Short identifier for this evidence item.
Short identifier for this evidence item (e.g. 'site-html', 'rfc-4.1.3').

anyOf.description: Multiple evidence items; each claim is also matched to the item it rests on.

tests.description: Reported test output for the patch review. Truncated at the same cap.

auto_accept.description: Review and per-claim confidence at or above this may stand automatically. Default 0.8.

review_at.description: Score, safe_to_apply, or per-claim confidence below this escalates. Must be <= auto_accept. Default min(0.5, auto_accept).

composite_floor.description: Weighted composite at or above this is required for auto. Default 0.7.
